v2Threats.scenario: Fungible-only and immutable-empty-NFT native records collide in a lossy projection.
v2Threats.control: role-selected closed TokenObservationV2 rejects both outside state language

v2Threats.scenario: A caller labels a transaction as another network or a fork has identical deployment history.
v2Threats.control: network is an embedded static manifest label only
v2Threats.residual: identical-history physical-chain replay is not detectable by current relation

v2Threats.scenario: An otherwise identical state/carrier script is moved to another input.
v2Threats.control: local OP_INPUTINDEX equality to fixed manifest role index

v2Threats.scenario: Payloads are reordered, resegmented, or retain equal payloads under different complete unlocking scripts.
v2Threats.control: all full unlocking bytecodes and canonical push framing enter the ordered carrier-session root

v2Threats.scenario: A caller injects a context, session, deployment, envelope, or schedule digest.
v2Threats.control: relation input has no derived digest fields; validator recomputes all

v2Threats.scenario: Concrete locks, downstream genesis records, or provenance roots influence an ancestor runtime commitment.
v2Threats.control: runtime manifest core excludes all concrete/provenance fields; provenance object is separately off-chain

v2Threats.scenario: Always-false fixture locks are presented as a deployable accepting covenant.
v2Threats.control: canonical trailing OP_FALSE and explicit nonclaim
